data.body: Done definition update from /dso:preplanning Phase 2 extension (5d6e-86a9): CLAUDE.md (or relevant referenced doc) explicitly distinguishes between (a) CI review provider config (model.provider, model.{light,standard,deep}) — provider-pluggable, and (b) local agent dispatch / file-impact / semantic-conflict model config (model.haiku, model.sonnet, model.opus) — Anthropic-pinned. The two namespaces must not be conflated. DSO_LLM_MODEL is documented as removed/no-op with migration guidance to model.{light,standard,deep}.
